verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a `service_tier: "priority"` option that explicitly gives faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput, which addresses the story's core. Dedicated autoscaling instances on H100/H200/B200/B300 GPUs add a path for latency-sensitive workloads, and a community report says cold starts are generally under 10s and rare on popular models. Missing for 10: concrete TTFT or tokens-per-second figures, independent benchmarks or hands-on latency corroboration, any documented streaming support, and clarity that the priority gains apply beyond peak demand and on more than a subset of supported models.
